summary: ArbiCore UI v2 · Slice 0 Emergent Preview verification. All 6 backend endpoint tests passed (pulse, deck, opportunities/summary, roi-probability, system/status, deck?limit). All 48 frontend/UI checks passed: shell mounted at /v2, header 7 slots present with correct testids + text, left rail 7 links present, Home aria-current=page, 3 home cards render with real pulse/deck data (CALM 82% confidence, 14 opps / 4 families / 47 routes, 5 deck items). Rail navigation to /v2/{discovery,opportunities,portfolio,intelligence,operations,settings} works and each renders v2-placeholder-<key>. Design fidelity confirmed: obsidian #0b0f14 canvas, 48px header, 64px rail, IBM Plex Mono brand, 2px border-radius, no drop shadow, amber (#ffb224 = rgb(255,178,36)) active rail marker on Home. Legacy landing at / renders stub only (no v2 chrome) — isolation proven.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is small and clean; UI v2 pod stubs are clearly labeled as preview stubs pointing to canonical repo — good.

featureFlag.js is defined but the /v2 route is unconditionally mounted in App.js — the flag is effectively a no-op in this preview pod. Not a bug for Slice 0 (preview is meant to be always-on), but for the Contabo VPS deploy the AppShell/route should be gated behind isUiV2Enabled() so production respects REACT_APP_ENABLE_UI_V2. Flag for main agent.
v2Api uses withCredentials:true but there's no auth in the pod; harmless here but worth confirming CORS config in canonical repo tolerates credentials.
HomePage's useAsync depends on a fresh fn each render but disables exhaustive-deps — acceptable, effect only fires once via cancelled flag; consider memoising the caller for future slices.
test_credentials: None required — /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present; auth is stubbed to {user: preview} in the pod as documented in the request.
seed_data_creation: None — backend endpoints are static preview stubs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slice 0 is green end-to-end in preview. When Slice 1 lands, retest the pulse->priorities->vitals full layout and ⌘K palette activation (palette-trigger should become enabled). The 4 dashboard endpoints are pod-local stubs; canonical implementation lives in /app/canonical_repo/app/backend/arbicore/routes/dashboard.py and must be validated separately for VPS deploy. Also verify feature-flag gating (see code review comment #2) before production cutover.
